vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek sighs. "I need some space. A corner nobody needs me in. Is that okay?" (Talk to A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek came back with 548 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 274 kcal in, 274 kcal eaten at the fire.
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek sighs. "I need some space. A corner nobody needs me in. Is that okay?" (Talk to A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek telling A woman, maybe 20s about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
🍲 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek eats with A person, maybe 50s — bowls side by side, talk low.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek drew a tree with feathery leaflets and pale green round fruit in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
You've started noticing: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek and Grace never speak. It's not new. (Something old lives in Haven.)
📋 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek telling Grace about A woman, maybe 20s. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
✅ You saw the creek. A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek paces the hall, restless, then sits. Then paces.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
Someone's retelling it again — Isaac, out past the ridge. A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says "Isaac would've gone farther if we'd let them."
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Isaac, Mario, Harald, Emma and Grace met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Isaac, Mario, Harald, Emma, Grace are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aki just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mario just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Isaac, Mario, Grace, Brian and Vasyl met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Isaac, Mario, Grace, Brian, Vasyl are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mario just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
